Subject: Signoff request: $20k promotional credits for NovaPulse PLG uplift

Hi team,

Quick ask — NovaPulse (contact: Sara Mitchell) just crossed 1.2M tokens in their first 7 days and their usage curve suggests a rapid cohort expansion. They're a fast-growing PLG prospect; marketing wants to run an in-product accelerator where we seed heavy free credits to drive feature adoption and conversion.

Proposal: provide a one-time promotional grant of $20,000 in credits (to be consumed within 90 days) and a 90-day trial extension on their self-serve plan. In return, NovaPulse has committed to a co-marketing testimonial and an internal adoption milestone (50 paying seats or $X MRR within 180 days).

Why I'm escalating: $20k is above my sign-off threshold and finance/legal want leadership approval for promotional grants >$10k. I attached the mutual action plan and a short deal summary.

Deal details: deal_id NP-2027-0041; region: US; expected conversion target: 50 seats in 6 months.

Can someone sign off or propose conditions? If approved, I will issue credits through the self-serve grant flow and notify the customer.

Thanks —
Marissa

Evelyn/Marissa —

I ran the quick numbers on cost-to-serve for the projected usage pattern from the MA Plan:
- Estimated incremental cost (GPU/networking) for 90 days: ~$6,400
- Expected lost revenue vs. accelerated conversion: We model a 60% chance of conversion to a paid plan within 180 days, which would offset the promo.

Recommendation: Approve up to $18,000 in promotional credits with the following controls:
1) Credits expire in 90 days and can only be applied to hosted usage (no refund for overages).
2) Require a signed MOU committing to the 50-seat target and a brief co-marketing blurb.
3) Cap per-request token rate after the first 60 days if usage is anomalous (we can throttle via routing policy).

If leadership prefers to be more aggressive for market signal reasons, $20k is doable but I'd like a conversion/commitment clause in the MOU.

-Michael

Thanks for the analysis. I support approving the full $20k promotional grant for NovaPulse under these conditions:

4) We log the grant as an exceptional promotional item and tag the deal NP-2027-0041.
